analysis: ordinal metrics, cumulative-threshold calibration, and external DCA

protocol.seed_aggregation: mean predicted probability at each patient
protocol.ordinal_c_index: Comparable pairs have different true ordered labels; predicted expected class is the score; score ties count 0.5.
protocol.quadratic_weighted_kappa: Maximum-probability class versus observed class; squared-distance weights.
protocol.ordinal_mae: Mean absolute difference between maximum-probability class and observed class.
protocol.multiclass_brier: Mean patient-level sum over classes of squared probability error against the one-hot observed class.
